        sums.add(cur)
        return
    rec(sums, arr, idx+1, (cur + arr[idx]) % mod, mod)
    rec(sums, arr, idx+1, cur, mod)

        target = m - l

import sys, bisect

def subset_sums(arr, mod):
    out = [0]
    for val in arr:
        out = out + [(x + val) % mod for x in out]
    return set(out)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); m = int(data[1])
    a = [int(x) % m for x in data[2:2+n]]
    h = n // 2
    left = subset_sums(a[:h], m)
    right = sorted(subset_sums(a[h:], m))
    best = 0
    for i in left:
        idx = bisect.bisect_left(right, m - i) - 1
        best = max(best, i + right[idx])
    print(best)

if __name__ == "__main__":
